name: When should I consider resurfacing my stucco?
description: Consider resurfacing for superficial cracks, fading, discoloration, or to update your home's exterior color or texture.

mainEntity.name: When should I consider resurfacing my stucco?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider resurfacing your stucco when you notice superficial cracks, fading, discoloration, or minor wear and tear that affects its appearance. It's also an excellent option if you want to change the color or texture of your home's exterior without the expense of full stucco replacement. If the underlying stucco is structurally sound with no significant water damage or widespread crumbling, resurfacing is a viable solution to restore its beauty and protection.
